definitions.explanation: the act of bringing something into a place; often refers to bringing one's own food or drinks to a venue

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}→飲食物：28440_inshokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{込|こ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Bringing in food and drinks is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{込|こ}みOK⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for an izakaya that allows bringing your own food.
The corkage fee for wine is 1,000 yen per bottle.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have/hold) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to bring into) → bringing in
- ⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧ (to bring in)

USAGE:
- Restaurants/bars: Bringing own food or alcohol
- Theaters/venues: Bringing food/drinks
- Airports: Bringing items through security
- Hotels: Bringing own bedding, pets, etc.

COMMON SIGNS:
- {持|も}ち{込|こ}み⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no outside food/drinks)
- {持|も}ち{込|こ}みOK (bringing in permitted)
- {持|も}ち{込|こ}み{可|か} (bringing in allowed)

RELATED WORDS:
- {持|も}ち{込|こ}み⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (corkage/bringing-in fee)
- ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧{持|も}ち{込|こ}み (bringing food and drinks)
- ⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り→持ち帰り：08161_mochikaeri⟧ (takeout - opposite direction)
- ⟦{差|さ}し{入|い}れ→差し入れ：08294_sashiire⟧ (gift/treat)
- ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no food or drink)
